note: NECO Islamic Studies Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - the Qur'an (revelation, compilation, surahs), Hadith (isnad, matn, collections), articles of faith, the five pillars (salat rak'ahs, zakat rate, Hajj rites), the Sirah (birth, call, hijrah, battles, opening of Makkah), the Khulafa' Rashidun, Islamic moral values, Muamalat, the spread of Islam in Nigeria (Kanem-Borno, Sokoto jihad), and the Islamic calendar and festivals. Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
